events.title: Patch V1.16
events.summary: Changelog:-Reworked Mirrors completely to be more performant.-Reworked Save system Caching. (this hopefully fixed save corruptions). Saving time improved by 5-10x, Loading time will be improved later too.-Reworked Menus completely. (added language, resolution and v-sync selection and fixed superwide resolutions)-Added side mirrors-Fixed Target FPS setting-Performance changes to the VHS filter. (caused high GPU temps before)-LTStudio
